# tuna_gateway (Resource)

A gateway attached to a reserved domain with a traffic policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tuna_domain" "app" {
  subdomain = "myapp"
  location  = "ru"
}

resource "tuna_gateway" "app" {
  domain_id = tuna_domain.app.id
  policy    = file("${path.module}/policy.yaml")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (Number) ID of the reserved domain the gateway is attached to.
- `policy` (String) Gateway traffic policy.

### Optional

- `request` (String) Original policy request the policy was generated from.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `location` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import tuna_gateway.app 123
```
